note: Page image 0002, the right-hand column, under "Berlin, d. 11. Januar 1797.": two signatures side by side. The question is the large one on the left: a tall looped A and then a row of short upright strokes with no clear ending. You read "Au[?]". I gave it as Alvensleben because he was one of the ministers of the department of foreign affairs in 1797 and signed beside Haugwitz, whose signature is the smaller one to the right. Nothing else in the edition carries his signature to compare. Pick "Alvensleben" if the name may stand without a mark of doubt, "Au[?]" to go back to your reading; "Can't tell" keeps it as it is, with the question mark.
